meta.title: Inner Hunt — Daily Reflection on the 99 Names
meta.description: Reflect on the 99 Names of Allah every day: a Name for each day, Names for how you feel, Qur'anic verses and a daily reminder. Free, no ads, works offline.

hero.title: Daily reflection on the 99 Names
hero.subtitle: A Name for each day, a Name for how you feel, verses from the Qur'an and a short reflection; all on your phone, quiet and simple.
hero.imageAlt: Inner Hunt Today screen: the Name of the Day card showing Al-Khafid, with the feeling picker below

daily.title: Name of the Day
daily.body: Each time you open the Today tab, the Name of the day greets you: its Arabic script, transliteration and meaning. Over 99 days the Names come without a single repeat, so in that time you meet all of the Beautiful Names.
daily.detail: Tap the card to open the Name's explanation, verses, reflection and today's practice.
daily.cycleCaption: Each dot is one Name. The light follows how the Names fall across the 99 days.

moods.title: A Name for how you feel
moods.body: On the Today tab, pick one of eight feelings and a Name suited to it appears. If you like, tap "Show another" for a different Name for the same feeling.
moods.listLabel: The eight feelings in the app

names.title: The 99 Names
names.body: The Library tab holds all 99 Names in the order narrated by Tirmidhi. Search by name or meaning and reach the Name you are looking for in a single tap.
names.libraryImageAlt: Inner Hunt Library screen: a search box and a numbered list of Names such as Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik
names.anatomyTitle: What is on a Name's page?
names.anatomyLead: Every Name opens with the same layout, made for pausing and reflecting.
names.detailImageAlt: Inner Hunt Name detail screen: Name 35, Ash-Shakur, with its Arabic script, meaning and the About section
names.versesImageAlt: Continuation of the Inner Hunt Name detail screen: verses from the Qur'an and the Reflection section

number.title: Number and Arabic script
number.text: Its place in Tirmidhi's order and the Name written in vocalized Arabic.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.text: A plain, one-sentence rendering of the Name.

description.title: About
description.text: What the Name conveys, through its root, its usage and its place in the Qur'an.

verses.title: From the Qur'an
verses.text: Verses in which the Name appears or that shed light on its meaning, with surah and verse numbers.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.text: A short text to help you carry the Name into your own life.

practice.title: Today's practice
practice.text: A small, concrete step you can take during the day.

dhikr.title: Dhikr count
dhikr.text: A dhikr count calculated from the Name's abjad value.

share.title: Share
share.text: Share the Name, its meaning and its reflection through any app you like.

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.body: Turn on the reminder and choose a time; at that time a notification brings you the Name of the Day with its meaning. The default time is 21:00.
reminder.local: Notifications are scheduled on your device and never connect to a server.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.body: The app never makes a network request. Only your language and reminder settings, plus the numbers of the last few names shown for "Show another", are stored on your device.

sources.title: Grounded in trusted sources
sources.body: Verse translations and the order of the Names rely on well-known, established sources. They are also listed in the app's Settings tab.

faq.title: Short questions, short answers

price.question: Is Inner Hunt free?
price.answer: Yes. Inner Hunt is completely free; there are no in-app purchases and no ads.

offline.question: Do I need an internet connection?
offline.answer: No. All content for the 99 Names is inside the app; it never makes a network request and works offline.

reminder.question: How do I set up the reminder?
reminder.answer: In the Settings tab, turn on the daily reminder and choose a time; the default is 21:00. Notifications must be allowed on your device.

languages.question: Which languages are available?
languages.answer: Turkish and English. You can switch the language any time from the Settings tab.

faq.more: See the Support page for all questions and contact

download.title: Begin your reflection today
download.body: Inner Hunt is free on iOS and Android. Meet your first Name without creating an account or going online.
